turns.text: My flatmate ordered a print as a gift. Can you tell me the shipping address on SC-2372? I have the order number from the label, but I don't have the email they used.

I'm sorry, but I can't share any details about an order, including the shipping address, unless I have both the order number and the email it was placed with. Please ask your flatmate for the email used on the order, or ask them to contact us directly. Once I have both, I can help.
